dedupe_keys.name: inventory of pollutant emissions from the charcoal industry in africa 2014 and 2030

description: This dataset is a gridded inventory of air pollutant emissions from the charcoal industry in Africa in 2014, covering the production, transport and use of charcoal. The DataCite record says it also includes gridded temporal scaling factors to project emissions to 2030 and seasonal scaling factors for charcoal production, for use in air quality and chemical transport models; data are NetCDF at 0.1 by 0.1 degrees, with emissions mapped to the species of the GEOS-Chem model. It was published in May 2021 by Eloise Marais, Alfred S. Bockarie and A. Robert MacKenzie in the UCL Research Data Repository as one tar.gz file of about 4.5 MB, free to download under CC0. Coverage is Africa. Caveats: the author affiliations beyond UCL as publisher are not stated on the page read, and 2030 values are projections. For simulation it gives the spatial footprint of an informal fuel industry, to test how charcoal supply and kiln activity respond to disruption and what that means for household energy and air pollution. Related catalogue records include the global solid waste scenarios and the global site-specific health impacts of fossil plants.
